One Piece

As a child, Monkey D. Luffy dreamed of becoming the King of Pirates. But his life changed when he accidentally gained the power to stretch like rubber … at the cost of never being able to swim again! Now Luffy, with the help of a motley collection of nakama, is setting off in search of “One Piece,” said to be the greatest treasure in the world …
